title: An Autopsy of a Digital Mind

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its strongest invitation is attentive reading that keeps literary force answerable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the preface before entering the four major experiments.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Choose a passage that feels revealing, then inspect what it actually claims.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ask whether it describes a pattern, proposes a cause, or makes a judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Return to nearby paragraphs before letting one sentence stand alone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Compare the recurring family, witness, and court images across chapters.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book suits readers interested in philosophy, literary persuasion, and artificial intelligence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its reward is a closer encounter with insight and its uncertain authority.
